records.name: Hear Between Notes
records.why: Beyond the 12-fret map: microtonal colour, bends, maqam/raga/blues territory.
records.practice: Bend slowly between two frets and hold the in-between pitch until it stops sounding wrong.

records.name: Find Your Voice
records.why: Beyond copying technique: touch, tone, timing and identity become unmistakable.
records.practice: Play one simple phrase three ways until one version sounds like you.

records.name: Transform Skill Into Art
records.why: Beyond exercises: harmony, rhythm and tuning become a personal world.
records.practice: Take one known chord shape and alter tuning/voicing until it suggests a new song.

records.name: Transmit The Fire
records.why: Beyond personal ability: you can guide another person through the path.
records.practice: Teach a beginner one concept without jargon, then watch where they get stuck.
